```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

jobs:
  clang-analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/rsyslog/devcontainer:latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Install LLVM and Clang
      uses: KyleMayes/install-llvm-action@v2
      with:
        version: "15"

    - name: Configure with scan-build
      run: |
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        scan-build-15 cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
        scan-build-15 --use-cc=clang-15 --use-c++=clang++-15 \
          --analyze-headers \
          --enable-all-checks \
          --exclude-pattern=".*test.*" \
          --exclude-pattern=".*third_party.*" \
          make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Upload scan-build results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: clang-static-analysis-report
        path: build/scan-build-15
        retention-days: 7

    - name: Log artifact URL
      run: |
        echo "Scan-build report available at: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
```
